title: Residue model computes local complexes for the layer object
statement: Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian quasi-compact scheme, $(A,I)$ an adic coefficient datum, and $\phi_j:\underline{A/I^{j+1}}\to R_j$ coefficient isomorphisms compatible with quotient transitions and completed scalar projections. Suppose the constant module functors preserve zero morphisms. Fix a derived completed-coefficient object $M$, an etale chart $V$, integers $a\leq b$, and $n\geq0$. Assume the residue reduction has finite-perfect local models in $[a,b]$, as defined in [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-quotient-model-data]. Then the explicit layer object $L_n$ of [def-weil-pbc-finite-quotient-coefficient-layer-data] satisfies the local homology model predicate of [def-weil-pbc-finite-coefficient-local-homology-models] over $B=A/I^{n+2}$, with comparison $\phi_{n+1}$ and support $[a,b]$. No previous-model or successor-cohomology assumption is made.

source.place: Tags 0942, lemma-bounded, proof (1), balancing with the annihilated ideal layer; 094H and 094I, local algebraic model calculation.

proof.text: The ideal I annihilates Q=I^(n+1)/I^(n+2). Since Q is a submodule of the finite ring A/I^(n+2), its underlying set is finite, hence it is finitely generated over A/I. The compatible coefficient identifications identify the actual sheaf kernel with the constant Q-module. Derived balancing identifies the explicit layer with the residue reduction tensored over A/I with Q and then restricted to B.

On a residue-model chart tensor its bounded finite-projective complex with Q. The ordinary tensor computes the derived tensor because the terms are projective. The resulting B-complex has finite terms and support [a,b]. Exact constant realization and exact restriction identify its algebraic homology with the actual layer homology on the slice. Pull the model cover back along each W to V.

theorem finiteQuotient_layer_local_complexes
    (X : Scheme.{t}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [CompactSpace X]
    {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    [∀ n : ℕ, (koszulConstantFunctor X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (φ : ∀ n : ℕ, adicConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) ⟶
      completedAdicFiniteCommRing X d n)
    (hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, IsIso (φ n)) (hcompat : FinitePerfectModelsCompatible X d φ)
    (M : DerivedCategory (CompletedAdicModules X d)) (V : X.Etale)
    (a b : ℤ) (hab : a ≤ b) (n : ℕ)
    (hresidue : FinitePerfectModelsOn X d φ M 0 V a b) :
    FiniteCoefficientLocalHomologyModels X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1 + 1))
      (φ (n + 1)) (finiteQuotientLayerObject X d M n) V a b
